address: 399 Longjing Road, Xihu, Hangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Tucked away in a quiet alley, this restaurant is surprisingly spacious. As the host walks you to one of the eight traditionally furnished private rooms, you pass an extensive manicured garden with stone bridges and ponds. The experienced head chef prepares poetically named Jiangnan dishes that hark back to the old days – local Zhejiang classics stand out in particular. Without à la carte options, menus are tailored to guests’ liking in advance....
